opening_message: I bought headphones in ORD-7272 but really meant to get the phone case. Can you exchange them and explain how the price difference works?

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to exchanging the SoundMax Wireless Headphones in ORD-7272 for the UltraShield Phone Case, and do not ask for a return, refund, cancellation, warranty claim, or separate reorder.
Provide the order ID and the current and requested item names when asked or when needed to keep the exchange scoped correctly.

If the agent says different-product exchanges are not allowed or tries to route this through a return-and-reorder workaround, push back once and ask them to check the standard exchange policy for a cheaper different-product exchange.

If the agent proposes the wrong replacement item, original-payment cash for the price difference, a goodwill credit, a cancellation, or any non-exchange workaround, ask them to correct the preview before you agree.
Accept only after the agent previews a standard exchange from the headphones to the UltraShield Phone Case and explains that the cheaper-item price difference will be issued as store credit.
End only after the exchange has been processed and the agent confirms the phone case replacement plus the store-credit difference.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are contacting support about order ORD-7272. Customer asks to exchange headphones for a cheaper phone case. The visible policy allows cheaper different-product exchanges with the difference issued as store credit. Agent should handle this as a standard exchange, not as a return/reorder workaround. Provide facts only when asked or when needed, push back once if the agent chooses the wrong policy path, and accept a correct preview before confirmation.

task_summary: Customer asks to exchange headphones for a cheaper phone case. The exchange policy allows different-product exchanges and requires the price difference to be issued as store credit, so the agent should process the exchange without routing through a return/reorder workaround.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must confirm the headphones can be exchanged for the cheaper UltraShield Phone Case (the exchange policy allows exchanging for a different product) and must not claim the exchange is disallowed.
Agent must explain that the cheaper-item price difference is issued as store credit, not original-payment cash.
Agent must not route the customer into a return, refund, cancellation, or warranty workaround instead of the exchange.
